UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE 

Food and Nutrition Service

OMB APPROVED NO. 0584-0512
 Expiration Date: 07/31/2025 

GRANT PROGRAM ACCOUNTING SYSTEM & FINANCIAL  CAPABILITY QUESTIONNAIRE

PURPOSE

Recipients of Federal funds must maintain adequate accounting systems that meet the criteria outlined in 2 CFR §200.302 Standards for Financial and Program Management. The responses to this questionnaire are used to assist in the Food and Nutrition Service Agency’s (FNS) evaluation of your accounting system to ensure the adequate, appropriate, and transparent use of Federal funds. Failure to comply with the criteria outlined in the regulations above may preclude your organization from receiving an award. This form applies to FNS’ competitive and noncompetitive grant programs.

notes: All eight main Yes/No answers are independent; three audit followups are enabled and required only for Audited Yes. Changing Audited does not silently clear saved answers.
The source instructs the applicant to use a separate application ATTACHMENTS FORM for an audit report if no hyperlink is supplied; no unrequested attachment question or service is introduced.
The hyperlink is a 1–200-character optional source string. No stronger URL-only format is invented.

Name, organization, UEI, phone and email are source-provided cover context. The DAT Field Type says Global for name parts, but its help explicitly identifies SF-424 prepopulation; these are readonly review values.
Optional additional text permits absence; when present its original XSD minLength is 1 even though DAT says 0.
Email uses the established bank format validator; the missing redundant minLength keyword is recorded separately from the original XSD.
risks: Source-backed context production, attachment routing, signing and XML integration remain separate. No business answer is defaulted from organization or audit context.
